title: Cracked Cosmic Egg
description: A giant cracked white egg with a cartoon face floats in a dark swirling sky above a colorful town. A green snake coils around it, red liquid drips from cracks and wounds, while a robotic arm holds a bouquet of flowers and a wristwatch. Two women in patterned dresses walk on a path scattered with puzzle pieces below.
prompt: Surreal painting of a giant cracked egg with a smiling cartoon face and large eyes floating in a dark purple swirling sky. A green snake wraps around it with red liquid dripping from cracks. A robotic arm extends from the left holding flowers and a watch. Below is a small town with Apollo Greenhouse Arcade signs, two women in colorful patterned dresses walking on a path with puzzle pieces and a red puddle, vibrant oversized flowers in the foreground, palm tree growing from the top of the egg, dramatic and whimsical atmosphere.
